acceptance_criteria: The reply states the machine's hostname.
The reply states the current Windows user.
The result email uses the exact subject [JARVIS-RESULT] probe-hostname-001.
goal: On the bridge PC, open a shell and run `hostname` and `whoami`. Capture both outputs. Take a PNG screenshot of the desktop and attach it. Change nothing on the machine — this is a read-only probe. Report back with the exact result subject: [JARVIS-RESULT] probe-hostname-001.
report_back: The hostname, the username, and the screenshot.
